name: Shrouded (Whisperer)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Variant: Whisperer (the book gives one block with three variants; each has its own id).

traits.name: Mist Form
traits.summary: Can stop in a creature's space; slips through gaps an inch wide at no extra cost.
traits.text: The shrouded may enter another creature's space and stay there, and squeezes through spaces as narrow as an inch without paying extra movement.

traits.name: Corrupting Mist
traits.summary: A creature starting its turn in its space: DC 13 Con save or 3d6 Necrotic (half on a success); a Humanoid killed this way rises as a shrouded.
traits.text: Constitution save, DC 13, for a creature that starts its turn in the shrouded's space. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, half on a success. The soul of a Humanoid killed by this damage becomes a new shrouded at the start of the shrouded's next turn, acting on that Initiative, and the Humanoid cannot be revived until the new shrouded is destroyed.

traits.name: Graveyard Warding
traits.summary: Can't move through a space with a barrier or line of iron (a wrought-iron fence, a line of iron filings).
traits.text: A barrier or line of iron is impassable to the shrouded, and the barrier reaches a mile up.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.text: A touch that withers the soul: 6 (1d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Toxic Thoughts
actions.summary: 30-ft emanation, DC 13 Int save (Constructs and Undead exempt): 2d6 Psychic and Frightened until its next turn; half damage on a success.
actions.text: A whispered litany of every failing: each creature within 30 feet that is not a Construct or Undead makes a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) Psychic damage and becoming Frightened until the start of the shrouded's next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

summary: A fog of whispers that lists every weakness of the living; it drains hope in a wide circle.
